title: Add visual feedback for "Save session" action
line: Clicking Save Session now shows a "Session Saved" notification once the session has been saved.
explanation: Save Session (Kickoff/Kicker Session menu, KRunner) asks ksmserver to checkpoint the session, which happens asynchronously and silently: nothing on screen tells the user whether it worked. ksmserver now sends a standard system notification ("Session Saved", with the system-save-session icon) when the checkpoint completes, after every client has saved its state.

commits.message:
ksmserver: show a notification when the session has been saved

Saving the session from the launcher or KRunner gave no feedback at all,
so there was no way to tell whether it had worked. Once every client has
finished saving, ksmserver now shows a "Session Saved" notification.

BUG: 468551

patches.diff:
From 61895a5244dd5f9ed73d3f61f5266ca8eb1582b5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 22:22:43 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] ksmserver: show a notification when the session has been
 saved

Saving the session from the launcher or KRunner gave no feedback at all,
so there was no way to tell whether it had worked. Once every client has
finished saving, ksmserver now shows a "Session Saved" notification.

BUG: 468551
---
 ksmserver/logout.cpp | 4 ++++
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+)

diff --git a/ksmserver/logout.cpp b/ksmserver/logout.cpp
index c1daa435d7..41ab5dafdd 100644
--- a/ksmserver/logout.cpp
+++ b/ksmserver/logout.cpp
@@ -364,6 +364,10 @@ void KSMServer::completeShutdownOrCheckpoint()
             SmsSaveComplete(c->connection());
         }
         state = Idle;
+        KNotification::event(KNotification::Notification,
+                             i18nc("@title:notification", "Session Saved"),
+                             i18nc("@info:status", "The applications that are open now will be restored the next time you log in."),
+                             QStringLiteral("system-save-session"));
     }
 }
 
--

media.caption: A few seconds after clicking Session > Save Session in Kickoff: the session was saved (ksmserverrc rewritten) but nothing is shown
Same action with the fix: a "Session Saved" notification appears
Clicking Save Session gives no feedback
Clicking Save Session shows the notification

review.text: Clean, minimal fix in the right layer (ksmserver/logout.cpp): sending the notification in the Checkpoint completion branch ensures feedback is shown only once the save actually finishes and covers all entry points (Kickoff, Kicker, KRunner, D-Bus) without affecting logout/shutdown. Proper i18nc contexts, clear user-facing copy, and the standard system-save-session icon are verified cleanly on Plasma 6.9 Dev.

reviews.text: Clean, minimal fix in the right layer (ksmserver/logout.cpp): sending the notification in the Checkpoint completion branch ensures feedback is shown only once the save actually finishes and covers all entry points (Kickoff, Kicker, KRunner, D-Bus) without affecting logout/shutdown. Proper i18nc contexts, clear user-facing copy, and the standard system-save-session icon are verified cleanly on Plasma 6.9 Dev.

This implements what Nate suggested in c1: ksmserver sends a plain system notification from the Checkpoint branch of completeShutdownOrCheckpoint(), so it reports a save that actually finished rather than a click. The only Checkpoint trigger is saveCurrentSession(/As), which in Plasma comes only from the user's Save Session (via plasma-shutdown's saveSession), so logout and shutdown never show it. KNotification and i18n are already used in logout.cpp, and the screenshot and video show the notification. Nitpick: a confirmation like this could be flagged transient so it stays out of notification history, but that is up to the maintainer.
